note: Each entry links a raw diagnostic to a disposition. Imported dependency-only diagnostics remain with the shared-dependency/global review.

diagnostics.description:
Alchemist.harvest(address) (src/Alchemist.sol#368-443) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- take = (d + scale - 1) / scale (src/Alchemist.sol#392)
	- asDebt = take * scale (src/Alchemist.sol#394)
diagnostics.disposition: Reviewed rounding: Alchemist ceils debt-to-assets then caps debt reduction; V2 follows canonical UQ112 reserve-ratio truncation before time accrual; hook rounds measured impact to integer bps, then stays between configured floor and hard-capped surge ceiling. No proven harmful loss from this rule.

diagnostics.disposition: Intentional discrete/sentinel check: same-block separation, zero share early return, uninitialized pool/ballot/average, or exact prior-UTC-day binding. None compares a manipulable external token balance to a nonzero fixed expected amount.

diagnostics.description:
Reentrancy in Alchemist.harvest(address) (src/Alchemist.sol#368-443):
	External calls:
	- e.withdraw(take + fee,address(this)) (src/Alchemist.sol#417)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- debtOf[user] = d - asDebt (src/Alchemist.sol#418)
	Alchemist.debtOf (src/Alchemist.sol#103) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- Alchemist.debtOf (src/Alchemist.sol#103)
diagnostics.disposition: False positive: all Alchemist state-mutating position entry points are nonReentrant. Harvest rechecks actual collateral after vault withdrawal before funding. Public views can observe an intermediate value, but no in-scope consumer performs a mutation from that view during a callback.

diagnostics.description: CollateralEscrow.withdraw(uint256,address) (src/CollateralEscrow.sol#81-83) ignores return value by vault.withdraw(assets,to,address(this)) (src/CollateralEscrow.sol#82)
diagnostics.disposition: Intentional: escrow measures actual share-balance delta instead of trusting deposit return; vault withdraw share return is unused and subsequent Alchemist collateral is rechecked. Hook ignores LP/protocol fee fields it does not consume. Buyer ignores ballot display ticker/tally while binding asset key, token and active status.
